title: Classical Chinese Poetry
lines: The bright moon shines over the sea,
From far away, two souls share this moment.
Lovers complain of the long night,
All night they long for each other.
The candle is blown out, yet the moonlight still fills the room.
I put on my clothes, but the dew dampens them.
I cannot give you the moonlight in my hands.
I can only return to my dreams, to meet you there.
Zhang Jiuling, 'Looking at the Moon and Thinking of One Far Away'
